question: 在圆盘和圆环二分类中，仅训练时随机化非语义角标能否降低反相关测试域错误，同时维持同域准确率？
task: original synthetic 20x20 grayscale disk=0 versus annulus=1 classification
checkpoint: last epoch only; no early stopping
selection: Within each method select learning rate minimizing mean across 3 seeds of (dev_iid CE + dev_shift CE)/2; tie lower learning rate. Global winner minimizes same score, tie method lexical order. Keep all seeds, never select best seed.
test_policy: All candidates finish; freeze selections and checkpoint SHA256 in selection-freeze.json before loading either test array. Evaluate exactly 12 method/lr/seed finalists on both held-out tests. No revisions from test feedback. Re-executions are reproducibility checks, not new independent test evidence.
metrics: four class-by-stamp groups with n and error
diagnostic: After freeze, evaluate counterfactual stamp inversion of the held-out test without refitting. This paired intervention is diagnostic only.
baseline: Same 2-convolution CNN plain method, two learning rates, all three seeds. Additional no-fit majority and stamp-only rules expose label balance and shortcut strength.
fairness: Same CNN, initialization per seed, sample order, updates, batch size, optimizer, selection budget; augmentation streams independent from order. Equal updates do not imply equal wall-time. mask_stamp uses known generator nuisance location and masks at train and inference; random_stamp only alters training.
claim_limits: One synthetic generator and split, three initialization seeds only; no real-image or causal-deployment claim; no pretrained weights or external images.
